name: Translate
description: Translate text locally — detects the language, targets your system language
author: spotty
help:
Trigger: translate

Type "translate <text>" to translate it: the source language is detected and the text is translated into your system language. Stop typing for 3 seconds (or press Enter on the "Translating…" row) and the result appears right here — press Enter on the translation to copy it.

Pick another target from the expanded list, or type a language after your text ("hello po" → Portuguese). "Back to Auto" returns to the system language.

Runs 100% locally through a LibreTranslate instance (default http://localhost:5000) — your text never leaves this machine. Start it once with: pip install libretranslate && libretranslate
